summary: The ServiceCode class manages service coding within the HSPnet framework, including operations for retrieval and localization.
purpose: Handles service code data, providing methods for accessing service code lists and options based on course and timetable.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Abbreviated name of the service code

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Descriptive name of the service code

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Determines the display order of the service code

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Additional notes for the service code

workflows.name: Service Code Retrieval by Course
steps: Add course ID and session ID as parameters.
Retrieve and populate service code list.

workflows.name: Service Code Retrieval by Timetable
steps: Add timetable ID and session ID as parameters.
Retrieve and populate service code list.

system_behavior: The class interacts with the database through stored procedures to fetch service codes based on course ID or timetable ID.
